title: A stranger's brew tap may refuse our tap as untrusted
body: Seen at the 3.0.1 cut on Homebrew main with an empty trust store, and not measured on stable: `brew tap` may refuse `matthewsinclair/intent` as untrusted, so the install docs may need `brew trust --tap matthewsinclair/intent`. Measure on stable first. Carried in `intent/wip.md` until 2026-09-13.
